question: Which among the following has written the book ‘The Pregnancy Bible’?
solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**Kareena Kapoor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "The Pregnancy Bible" by Kareena Kapoor:
 
• It is a comprehensive guide to pregnancy, covering everything from conception to birth.
 
• It is written in a warm and engaging style and is full of personal anecdotes from Kareena's own pregnancies.
 
• It features contributions from experts in a variety of fields, including doctors, nutritionists, and fitness trainers.
 
• It is packed with information on everything from diet and exercise to labor and delivery.
 
• It is an essential resource for any woman who is pregnant or planning to become pregnant.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are some of the topics covered in the book:

 
• Pregnancy basics: This section covers everything from how to get pregnant to the first trimester.
 
• Diet and nutrition: This section provides guidance on how to eat a healthy diet during pregnancy.
 
• Exercise: This section provides advice on how to stay active during pregnancy.
 
• Labor and delivery: This section covers everything from the signs of labor to the different stages of delivery.
 
• Postpartum care: This section provides information on how to care for yourself and your baby after delivery.
